The '''Hapan Royal Communications Authority''' was an organization within the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]].

{{RPG|"[[Nightsaber]]"}}
Circa [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and used a [[Dathomir communications center|communications center]] on the world to prevent the occupation from being detected by off-worlders. A group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] agents attacked the center and used it to send a message to [[Teneniel Djo]], the Hapan [[Queen Mother]], requesting Hapan assistance, which was received by the Hapan Royal Communications Authority.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Hapan Royal Communications Authority was created by [[J.D. Wiker]] and featured in ''[[Nightsaber]]'', a [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] supplement that was released on [[Wizards.com]] in [[2003]]. In the scenario, the players [[Roleplaying game|role-play]] as the Jedi agents that attack the Dathomir communications center and it is possible for them to contact the Communications Authority.
